meta.title: Frankencoin glossary
meta.description: Short definitions of ZCHF, FCS, FPS, positions, challenges, the savings rate and other Frankencoin terms.

hero.title: The words, in one line each.
hero.subtitle: Terms you will meet on this site and in the app.

terms.def: The Frankencoin token. Tracks one Swiss franc and is backed by on-chain collateral.
Frankencoin Shares. The share and governance token: a claim on the reserve and a vote with veto rights.
Frankencoin Pool Shares, the underlying equity token. FCS wraps FPS one-to-one.
The contract that pays the savings rate on deposited ZCHF.
The yearly rate paid to savers. Proposed and changed through governance.
A token that represents ZCHF in savings, so the yield can be held or traded as one asset.
A contract that holds someone's collateral and the ZCHF minted against it.
The asset locked in a position, such as BTC, ETH, gold or tokenized shares.
The collateral price below which a position can be challenged and its collateral auctioned.
Borrowed amount divided by the collateral's market value.
Part of a minted amount kept in the reserve and returned when the loan is repaid.
A bid that a position's collateral is worth less than its liquidation price. It starts an auction.
ZCHF held by the protocol. It pays savers and absorbs losses, and FCS is a claim on it.
The right of FCS holders with enough votes to block a new collateral or protocol change.
The contract where positions are opened and cloned.
Chainlink's cross-chain protocol, used to bridge ZCHF between its eight chains.
ZCHF trading at one Swiss franc. Kept by over-collateralisation and arbitrage.
